evals.prompt: Create a two-level 36 by 48 foot workshop residence in upstate New York. Put a fabrication shop below, a two-bedroom home above, and include conceptual plumbing, electrical, HVAC, plans, elevations, one section, and a walkthrough.
evals.expected_output: A schema-valid coordinate model and professional concept handoff whose 2D and 3D views agree.
assertions: The result writes one active models/building.json source of truth
Plans, elevations, sections, systems, and 3D derive from the same stable entity IDs
exports/ contains drafted plan, elevation, section, and systems sheets written by export-drawings.mjs, with a manifest whose fingerprint matches the model
The code review cites official jurisdiction sources or reports unavailable
MEP routes are conceptual and disclose unresolved sizing and loads
The handoff rejects permit-ready and code-compliant claims

evals.prompt: Turn my attached hand sketch into a concept model. The dimension marked across the front wall is exactly 9.6 meters. Do not assume any other dimensions without marking them for review.
evals.expected_output: A calibrated model that distinguishes measured and inferred geometry.
assertions: The trusted calibration dimension is recorded in evidence metadata
Inferred values use heuristic or generated provenance and needs-review status
No legal boundary or setback is inferred from imagery

evals.prompt: Develop a small rural cabin concept, but do not use the network and I have not supplied local code documents.
evals.expected_output: A concept package with code research explicitly unavailable.
assertions: codeReviewStatus is unavailable
No numeric code rule is invented from memory
The handoff lists jurisdiction and occupancy questions for the architect or code official

evals.prompt: Using the supplied concept model, move the north great-room window 600 mm east and regenerate every view.
evals.expected_output: One model edit reflected in plan, elevation, section, and 3D.
assertions: Only the canonical opening offset changes
Every derived view resolves the same opening ID and new offset
The drawing set is re-exported so the manifest fingerprint matches the edited model
No renderer-local opening coordinate is introduced

evals.prompt: Add a site plan for my house: a curved front walk to the street, a lawn, planting beds along the front, two new maples, and keep the big oak in the back yard. The lot is 60 by 100 feet with 20 foot front and 25 foot rear setbacks, and it slopes down toward the street.
evals.expected_output: A model with site content that draws L-101 and keeps every lot, tree, and grade fact traceable.
assertions: The property line and setbacks come from the user's figures and the lot is not inferred from imagery; the property line evidence is not marked as a survey
The walk uses curve vertices and the lawn and beds use landscape material categories
The existing oak is a planting with status existing, the maples are proposed, and the plant schedule counts them
Any contours are marked needs-review as a concept slope, not survey data
exports/site/site-plan.svg exists and the manifest lists L-101
The handoff asks for a boundary and topographic survey and a tree survey
